description:
Approached through impressive red brick entrance pillars and along a sweeping tarmacadam driveway, Dunard immediately creates a wonderful first impression. This attractive red brick dormer residence is a beautifully presented family home, built by its current owner with exceptional attention to detail and a clear emphasis on quality, comfort and thoughtful design. From the moment you step inside, it is evident that this is a home that has been carefully planned and lovingly maintained. The well-proportioned accommodation is bright, welcoming and ideally suited to modern family living, while the beautifully landscaped gardens provide an exceptional outdoor setting.

The front porch opens into a welcoming entrance hall, with a gallery area creating an impressive sense of space and leading to the first-floor landing. Straight ahead lies the kitchen, which forms the heart of this wonderful home. This generous space is complemented by a family room, providing the perfect setting for relaxed everyday living. A large dining room, featuring extensive glazing overlooking the gardens, creates a bright and inviting space for family meals and entertaining, and also a rear porch/sunroom. Further along the hallway is the formal living room, a beautifully proportioned reception space featuring a focal fireplace and double-aspect windows that flood the room with natural light. A dedicated study provides an ideal space for working from home, while a guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

Upstairs, the property offers four generously proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with beautiful en-suite shower room. Each bedroom has its own individual character and charm, providing comfortable and peaceful retreats for family members and guests alike. There is also a w.c and separate bathroom with shower.

LOCATION
Dunard is a beautiful red brick fronted dormer residence conveniently located at Crosschapel on the northern side of Blessington Village. The property is exceptionally well connected. Positioned just off the N81, access is seamless, while the 65 Dublin Bus route passes the door providing a direct link to the city. The Luas Park & Ride at Saggart is just a 12-minute drive, and the N7 and M50 motorways are also within close proximity, ensuring excellent connectivity to the wider Dublin region and beyond.
Blessington, one of the largest towns in West Wicklow, offers a perfect blend of history, natural beauty, and outdoor activities. Situated near the Blessington Lakes and Wicklow Mountains, the town is rich in heritage with notable landmarks such as the Credit Union House, Downshire Monument, and St. Mary`s Church of Ireland.

Blessington is well-connected via the N81, with easy access to Dublin and surrounding areas. The town offers convenient transport options, including bus services and a range of local amenities. Shops in Blessington cater to all needs, from local markets and convenience stores to larger branded stores.

Additional information
The stunning Russborough House, a magnificent Georgian mansion, is a must-visit, offering guided tours, beautiful gardens, and a hedge maze. The Blessington Lakes provide ample opportunities for outdoor activities including fishing, kayaking, and cycling, while the surrounding area boasts scenic walking trails like the Blessington Greenway and Mass Path.
For adventure enthusiasts, CP Adventure and Avon Activity Centre offer exciting outdoor pursuits such as ziplining and archery. After a day of exploration, visitors can enjoy Blessington`s vibrant culinary scene, with options ranging from food trucks at the Avon Food Village to cozy pubs like Murphy`s Bar and West Wicklow House. The town`s rich culture and natural beauty make it an ideal destination for both relaxation and adventure.

OUTSIDE
The gardens at Dunard are a particularly special feature of the property. Beautifully maintained and thoughtfully landscaped, they combine manicured lawns with mature planting, attractive herbaceous borders and an abundance of seasonal colour.
Deceptively spacious, the gardens are laid out in a series of charming divisions, each revealing something new as you explore. The mature planting and carefully considered layout create a wonderful sense of privacy, tranquillity and seclusion, while ensuring colour and interest throughout the year.
A generous rear patio provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and enjoying long summer evenings. A gazebo offers an additional sheltered space to relax and take in the garden surroundings.  There is also a large concrete shed with ESB, providing excellent storage and practical utility space. To the front, the extensive tarmacadam driveway offers ample parking for multiple vehicles. The attached garage with double doors can house a car but could also be converted into further accommodation should you wish to extend the home (subject to the necessary planning permission). It is currently used as a workshop/storage space with lofted ceiling.
Dunard is a truly appealing home that combines quality construction, generous accommodation and beautifully landscaped gardens in a highly desirable rural setting. Offering an exceptional balance of space, privacy and convenience, this is a property that will appeal to those seeking a wonderful family home in the Crosschapel and Blessington area.
